digest.component_or_area: ticket store reclaim window (epoch-guarded ref rewrite)
propositions: Execute a one-time force-with-lease rewrite of the tickets branch to reclaim 92% of storage after all writers (sessions, workflows, agents) are quiesced and zero active sessions confirmed by operator.

Verify pre-publication that the epoch-guard epoch.enforce_since is correctly pinned to the post-rewrite mapped SHA and that all pre-write assertions (tree identity, commit/merge counts, verify-identity event multisets) hold on a fresh unfiltered clone before publishing.

After publication, assert that the old tip is not an ancestor of any fetchable ref and that size-pack growth from the baseline is under 1 MB, proving the rewrite is irreversible and no stale writer can resurrect old history.

Restore all paused infrastructure (GitHub workflows, AWS timers, LaunchAgents, MCP servers) and validate post-window reconciliation with clean fsck and zero drift in the Jira canary, then notify operator that the tickets branch is available for new sessions.
